title: Muji language - Wikipedia
text: Language family. Sino-Tibetan. Lolo-Burmese. Loloish.Muji or Muzi is a Loloish language cluster spoken by the Phula people of China. It is one of several such languages to go by the name Muji. Muji varieties are Northern Muji, Qila Muji, Southern Muji, and Bokha–Phuma.[2].
